reply:
INT caps at 2,147,483,647 (10 digits) because it's 32-bit signed. The 11 is just a display width hint for ZEROFILL and doesn't limit storage. My answer was wrong—I confused the parentheses with an actual digit constraint.

For 12-digit numbers, yes, use BIGINT. But not because of the 20 in BIGINT(20)—that's also just a display hint. You need BIGINT because it's 64-bit signed, which goes up to 9,223,372,036,854,775,807. The parentheses in either case are cosmetic.
